extDescription.message: Creates a separate e-mail address per shop in the checkout form, through the shop address API of your mail server.

notConnected.message: The extension is not connected to your mail server yet.

connectHowto.message: The easiest way: in your webmail (Roundcube: Settings → Preferences → Shop address API) enter a device name, save and click “Connect browser extension”.

shop.description: Label of the shop name field

noFieldCopied.message: No input field found – the address was copied to the clipboard.

permissionNeeded.message: The extension needs access to websites to fill in e-mail fields and to reach your mail server.

connectionHint.message: The extension works with any mail server offering the shop address API, e.g. Roundcube with the identity_api plugin. The easiest way is to connect it right in your webmail (Roundcube: Settings → Preferences → Shop address API: enter a device name, save and click “Connect browser extension”). Alternatively enter the API URL and token here.

apiUrlHint.message: The URL of your mail server's shop address API (Roundcube: Settings → Preferences → Shop address API, section “Connection”).

tokenHint.message: One token per device, created on your mail server (Roundcube: Settings → Preferences → Shop address API).

optInlineButton.message: Show the button in e-mail fields

optCopy.message: Also copy the address when inserting it from the popup

overridesHint.message: If you change the suggested shop name, the extension remembers the name for that website.

learnedHint.message: Fields that are not recognizable as e-mail fields, into which you inserted an address from the popup or context menu. The button appears there automatically from now on.

httpsRequiredToken.message: The API URL has to start with https://, otherwise the token would be sent unencrypted.

connectHeading.message: Connect Shop Addresses to your mail server?

connectConfirmHint.message: Only confirm if this is the address of your mail server and you just chose “Connect browser extension” in its settings yourself.

warnReplaceServer.message: The extension is connected to $1 so far. This connection will be replaced.

warnReplaceToken.message: The previous token will be replaced by the new one.

warnInsecure.message: Unencrypted connection (only for tests on localhost).

connectedTo.message: Connected to $1 ($2). You can now create shop addresses in checkout forms.

connectFromPageOnly.message: Connecting is only possible from a web page.

connectOtherServer.message: The API is on a different server than the page. Please enter the URL and token in the extension's settings.

offerExpired.message: The request has expired. Please choose “Connect browser extension” in your webmail again.

menuCreate.message: Create and insert new shop address

notifyNoField.message: New address $1 – no field found to insert it.

notConfigured.message: The extension is not set up yet (API URL and token in the settings).

httpsRequired.message: The API URL has to start with https://.

timeout.message: The mail server did not answer in time.

invalidResponse.message: No valid API response (HTTP $1). Is the API URL right (Roundcube shows it under Settings → Preferences → Shop address API)?

err_domain_not_allowed.message: This domain is not allowed on the server.

err_rate_limit_exceeded.message: Too many new addresses in a short time. Please try again later.

err_address_too_long.message: Address too long. Please use a shorter shop name.

err_identities_disabled.message: Additional identities are not allowed on this server.

err_not_found.message: Not found (address deleted or wrong API URL).

err_delete_failed.message: The address could not be deleted.

err_no_domain_configured.message: No domain for new addresses is set up on the server.

buttonTitle.description: Tooltip of the button in e-mail fields

fieldGone.message: $1 created – the field no longer exists, please insert it with the extension's toolbar button.

extUnreachable.message: Extension not reachable ($1). Please reload the page.

panelNotConfigured.message: Not set up yet: create a token in your webmail (Roundcube: Settings → Preferences → Shop address API) and choose “Connect browser extension”, or

confirmInTab.message: Please confirm the connection in the extension's newly opened tab.
